## KaliScriber 0.3.6

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings and settings.

### Fix
- **Crash when starting speaker detection.** 0.3.5 crashed on Android 15 and later as soon as speaker detection, AI separation or a summary refresh started in the background. A support library dropped the service type Android needs, so Android refused to start the service. The app now sets that type itself, and if Android still refuses, the job keeps running instead of crashing.
